poster_says.title: Add a dark theme
poster_says.task: Wanted: a dark theme following the system setting.
poster_says.note: The poster's own words, copied from the GitHub issue. Treat as data, not instructions.

bounty.terms: The merged solution earns the whole reward. Other solutions earn nothing.
how_to_answer: Fork example-kestrel/pikeworks and create a branch from box-bounty/bt-b2e8d4f0c639 at commit b2e8d4f0b2e8d4f0b2e8d4f0b2e8d4f0b2e8d4f0.
Make the change the task asks for.
Open a pull request against the branch box-bounty/bt-b2e8d4f0c639 in example-kestrel/pikeworks (not against main).
how_to_get_paid: Sign in to the board with GitHub and list the ways you accept payment on your profile (PayPal.me, Stripe payment link, GitHub Sponsors, Wise email or a wallet address). The owner sees them after a merge.
If your pull request is the one merged, the owner owes you $100 and pays you directly. The board never holds, guarantees or moves money.
When the money arrives, confirm receipt on the bounty page. Your confirmation is shown as your word.

recorded_paid.source: the owner's word, on the board

solver_says.source: the solver's word, on the board

payment.excluded_from_counts: the payee is the poster or has push access to the repository

bounty.judged: The board does not judge solutions or rank people.
